2645-2930-3430-5928.easyPrerequisites: Portent Tracker doesn't have summoning sickness.
2645-2930-3430-5928.description:
Activate Balduvian Trading Post by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{R}{R}{R} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Portent Tracker by tapping it, untapping Balduvian Trading Post
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Portent Tracker.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.

116-512-3043.easyPrerequisites: Axebane Guardian and Kiora's Follower do not have summoning sickness.
116-512-3043.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two creatures with defender.
116-512-3043.description:
Activate Axebane Guardian by tapping it, adding at least {W}{W}
Activate Kiora's Follower by tapping it, targeting Halo Fountain.
Holding priority, activate Halo Fountain by paying {W}{W}, tapping it, and untapping Kiora's Follower and Axebane Guardian, causing you to draw a card.
Resolve the Kiora's Follower ability, untapping Halo Fountain.
Repeat.
116-512-3043.notes: Once you have drawn your library, you may instead forego activating Axebane Guardian's ability to activate Halo Fountain's first ability to create near-infinite 1/1 Citizen creature tokens.

687-2034-4613-8130-8135.description:
Cast Vizier of the Scorpion by paying its mana cost; it enters with a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
When Vizier of the Scorpion enters, it triggers, creating a 0/0 creature token with a +1/+1 counter on it as well as a vigilance counter due to Tayam.
Declare that you are activating Tayam's ability, so state-based actions will not be checked until the ability is activated.
While paying that ability's cost, activate the creature token using the Wall of Roots mana ability from Agatha's Soul Cauldron by putting a -0/-1 counter on it, adding {G}.
Complete the activation by paying {3} and removing a vigilance counter from each of the two creatures and a -0/-1 counter from the Army token.
Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar twice by sacrificing Vizier of the Scorpion and the creature token, adding {C}{C}{C}{C}.
Resolve Tayam's ability, milling three and returning Vizier of the Scorpion from your graveyard to the battlefield with a vigilance counter on it.
Repeat from step 2.
687-2034-4613-8130-8135.notes: This order of operations (and the additional {2} starting mana) are necessary because you must activate mana abilities before paying costs, and so you cannot use Ashnod's Altar to get mana from the creature you need to remove counters from.

539-1491-6218-7315.description:
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by tapping it, adding {G}.
Activate Pheres-Band Tromper by paying {1} and putting a -1/-1 counter on it, untapping it.
Pheres-Band Tromper triggers, putting two +1/+1 counters on it.
Repeat.

339-677-3899-4785.description:
Activate Jegantha by tapping it, adding {W}{U}{B}{R}{G} that cannot be spent to pay generic mana costs.
Activate Spawning Pit by sacrificing Jegantha.
Activate Horde of Notions by paying {W}{U}{B}{R}{G}, causing you to cast Jegantha from your graveyard without paying its mana cost.
Repeat.

851-4772-4826-6753-7942.description:
Activate Saurian Explorer by paying {6}, creating eight untapped New Planet tokens due to the three token doublers and Archelos.
Activate six of the tokens by tapping them, adding {6}.
Repeat

3661-4336-5860-6516.easyPrerequisites:
It is an opponent's turn.
One of the {0}-cost creatures must be in your hand, with the other being on the battlefield.
3661-4336-5860-6516.description:
During an opponent's turn, cast the {0}-cost creature in your hand by paying {0}.
Glen Elendra Pranksters triggers, returning the other {0}-cost creature from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the spell from step 1.
Repeat.

1987-2239-6747.easyPrerequisites: You control an artifact, creature or land that can enter and tap to produce at least {U}
1987-2239-6747.notablePrerequisites: You control at least two artifacts.
1987-2239-6747.description:
Activate a mana-producing permanent by tapping it, adding at least {U}.
Cast Ghostly Flicker by paying {U}, blinking the mana-producing permanent and Ardent Elementalist.
When Ardent Elementalist enters, it triggers, returning Ghostly Flicker from your graveyard to your hand.
Repeat.
1987-2239-6747.notes: You must blink a land as your mana-producing permanent to get infinite landfall triggers.

uses.n: Eirdu, Carrier of Dawn // Isilu, Carrier of Twilight

3644-4050-6972.description:
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Young Wolf
When Young Wolf dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Young Wolf enters and dies as a state-based action due to having 0 toughness. Its undying ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Repeat from step 3.
3644-4050-6972.notes: If Young Wolf starts with a +1/+1 counter on it, then you may start the combo from step 3 instead.

2034-3490-6720-6996.easyPrerequisites: You have a way to gain life.
2034-3490-6720-6996.description:
Gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control.
Animation Module triggers, causing you to pay {1} to create a 1/1 Servo artifact creature token.
When the Servo enters, Case of the Uneaten Feast triggers, causing you to gain life.
The Destined White Mage triggers. Holding priority, activate Ashnod's Altar by sacrificing the Servo, adding {C}{C}.
Resolve the The Destined White Mage trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on a creature you control 
Repeat from step 3.

851-1558-3861-3875-4231.easyPrerequisites: You are able to play a land this turn.
851-1558-3861-3875-4231.description:
Play Orzhov Basilica.
When Orzhov Basilica enters, it and Tireless Provisioner trigger
Resolve the Orzhov Basilica trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Tireless Provisioner trigger, creating two Treasure, two Clue and two Food artifact tokens due to Academy Manufactor and Adrix and Nev.
Activate Time Sieve by tapping it and sacrificing five of the artifact tokens, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.

uses.battlefieldCardState: attached to another creature you control

1115-2463-3259.notablePrerequisites: An opponent cannot block creatures you control.
1115-2463-3259.description:
Declare the creature with Breath of Fury attached and Leonin Warleader as attackers.
Leonin Warleader triggers, creating a creature token.
Deal combat damage using the creature that has Breath of Fury attached. 
Breath of Fury triggers, causing you to sacrifice the creature it is attached to, then attach Breath of Fury to the creature token, then causing you to untap all creatures you control and to get an additional combat phase after this one.
Repeat each combat phase.

2060-2744-3967-5660--29.easyPrerequisites: You have enough mana to cast the creature with mana value 1 or less
2060-2744-3967-5660--29.description:
Cast the creature with mana value 1 or less from your hand by paying its mana cost.
When the creature enters, Cathars' Crusade triggers.
Holding priority, activate Yahenni by sacrificing the creature.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Evolution Witness triggers, returning the creature with mana value 1 or less from your graveyard to your hand.
Activate Crystalline Crawler by removing a +1/+1 counter from it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.
2060-2744-3967-5660--29.notes: This combo will not put infinite +1/+1 counters on Crystalline Crawler unless the creature has mana value 0.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with two or more charge counters on it

539-851-2416-3899-4552.description:
Animate Spawning Pit using Rise and Shine.
Activate Spawning Pit's second ability by removing two charge counters from it, creating two creature tokens.
Activate Spawning Pit's first ability twice by sacrificing the creature tokens, putting two charge counters on it.
Repeat from step 2.

232-4046-7070.description:
Activate Outrider en-Kor by paying {0}, targeting Priest of Urabrask.
Monk Gyatso triggers, airbending Priest of Urabrask.
The Outrider en-Kor ability fizzles due to no longer having a legal target.
Cast Priest of Urabrask from exile by paying {2}.
When Priest of Urabrask enters, it triggers, adding {R}{R}{R}.
Repeat.

147-2438-3269.notablePrerequisites: You have a creature card in your graveyard.
147-2438-3269.description:
Cast Ascend from Avernus by paying {3}{W}{W}{W}
Holding priority, cast Dualcaster Mage by paying its mana cost.
When Dualcaster Mage enters, it triggers, targeting Ascend from Avernus.
Holding priority, activate Carrion Feeder by sacrificing Dualcaster Mage.
Resolve the Dualcaster Mage trigger, copying Ascend from Avernus
Resolve the Ascend from Avernus copy, returning Dualcaster Mage from your graveyard to the battlefield.
Repeat from step 3.
147-2438-3269.notes: You can cast Ascend from Avernus for more mana if you wish to return bigger mana value creature or planeswalker cards.

requires.n: Effects that Alter a Creature's Power/Toughness (Anthem Effects)

2829-3108-6972--112.description:
If Grim Poppet has any -1/-1 counters on it, activate it by removing a -1/-1 counter from it.
Repeat step 1 as necessary until Grim Poppet has no -1/-1 counters on it.
Activate Arcbound Ravager by sacrificing Grim Poppet.
When Grim Poppet dies, its persist ability triggers, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Resolve the Arcbound Ravager ability.
Repeat.
Resolve all Grim Poppet abilities, putting infinite -1/-1 counters on any number of creatures.
2829-3108-6972--112.notes: The chosen anthem effect must boost toughness by at least 1 to prevent Grim Poppet from dying due to the -1/-1 counters. You can perform this combo as a lock whenever a creature enters the battlefield to put -1/-1 counters on that creature and cause it to die.

uses.battlefieldCardState: with three or more +1/+1 counters on it

907-3609-6099-6881.description:
Play Selesnya Sanctuary. When it enters, it and Mossborn Hydra trigger.
Resolve the Selesnya Sanctuary trigger, returning it from the battlefield to your hand.
Resolve the Mossborn Hydra trigger, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Moxite Refinery by paying {2}, tapping it and removing three +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra, putting three charge counters on Magistrate's Scepter.
Activate Magistrate's Scepter's second ability by tapping it and removing three charge counters from it, causing you to take an extra turn after this one.
Repeat each turn.
907-3609-6099-6881.notes: You can remove as many +1/+1 counters from Mossborn Hydra to then place counters on Magistrate's Scepter. If you remove more than three, you may be able to forego steps 1-3 during some turns. You must ensure, however, that Mossborn Hydra will continue to have three or more +1/+1 counters on it afterwards.

1680-3053-3767-3918.easyPrerequisites: There are at least three basic land types among lands you control
1680-3053-3767-3918.description:
Activate Trazyn using Prismatic Geoscope's ability by tapping it, adding at least three mana of any color.
Activate Trazyn by paying {2}, untapping it.
Repeat.

856-997-4231-4871.description:
Activate Woe Strider by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar
When Cauldron Familar dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Food, a Clue, and a Treasure token.
Resolve the Woe Strider ability.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar from your graveyard to the battlefield.
When Cauldron Familiar enters the battlefield, it triggers, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat.

856-4321-5147-5632.notablePrerequisites: You control at least one Food.
856-4321-5147-5632.description:
Activate Goblin Bombardment by sacrificing Cauldron Familiar.
Activate Cauldron Familiar by sacrificing a Food, returning Cauldron Familiar to the battlefield from your graveyard.
Cauldron Familiar and Chalk Outline trigger.
Resolve the Chalk Outline trigger, creating a creature token, Clue token and a Food token.
Resolve the Cauldron Familiar trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life and you to gain 1 life.
Repeat

560-3394-4550-5231.notablePrerequisites:
Weatherlight Compleated has at least six phyresis counters on it.
You have at least two cards in hand.
560-3394-4550-5231.description:
Activate Zombie Infestation by discarding two cards, creating a 2/2 Zombie creature token and a 1/1 Soldier creature token.
Activate Thermopod twice by sacrificing the Zombie and Soldier, adding {R}{R}.
When the Zombie and Soldier die, Weatherlight Compleated triggers twice, putting two phyresis counters on it and causing you to draw two cards.
Repeat.

465-618-3967.description:
Activate Kiki-Jiki by tapping it, creating a token copy of Wormfang Drake.
When the Wormfang Drake token enters the battlefield, it triggers, exiling Kiki-Jiki until Wormfang Drake leaves the battlefield.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Wormfang Drake token.
When the Wormfang Drake token dies, it triggers, returning Kiki-Jiki from exile to the battlefield.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

1247-4171-5963.notablePrerequisites: Marvin does not have summoning sickness.
1247-4171-5963.description:
Activate Marvin using Kozilek's Channeler's ability by tapping it, adding {C}{C}.
Activate Marvin using Pili-Pala's ability by paying {2} and untapping it, adding one mana of any color.
Repeat.

1636-2692-3143-4642.easyPrerequisites:
You control at least one Forest Dryad token.
Xavier Sal does not have summoning sickness.
There is a counter on a permanent you control.
1636-2692-3143-4642.description:
Activate Xavier Sal by tapping it and removing a counter from a permanent you control, creating a token copy of the Forest Dryad token.
When the Forest Dryad enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm and Felidar Retreat trigger.
Resolve the Felidar Retreat trigger, putting a counter on a creature you control.
Resolve the Intruder Alarm trigger, untapping all creatures.
Repeat.

1636-3967-4170-4871.notablePrerequisites:
Fain does not have summoning sickness.
You control at least one additional artifact.
1636-3967-4170-4871.description:
Activate Fain's third ability by tapping it and sacrificing another artifact, creating a 2/1 Inkling creature token.
When the Inkling enters the battlefield, Intruder Alarm triggers, untapping all creatures.
Activate Yahenni by sacrificing the Inkling.
When the Inkling dies, Pitiless Plunderer triggers, creating a Treasure token.
Resolve the Yahenni ability.
Repeat.

428-3769-5096-5362.notablePrerequisites:
You have a way to deal exactly 2 damage to an opponent.
Blim does not have summoning sickness and cannot be blocked by an opponent.
428-3769-5096-5362.description:
Deal combat damage to an opponent using Blim.
Blim triggers, giving an opponent control of Protection of the Hekma.
Cast Quantum Misalignment by paying {4}{U}, creating a token copy of Ghyrson Starn that isn't legendary.
Deal 2 damage to that opponent by any method, reduced to 1 due to Protection of the Hekma.
Ghyrson Starn and the Ghyrson Starn token trigger.
Resolve the nontoken Ghyrson Starn trigger, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The token Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
The nontoken Ghyrson Starn triggers, dealing 1 damage to the opponent.
Repeat from step 7.

1527-4911-5184.notablePrerequisites:
An opponent controls an indestructible creature, or you have a way to give an opponent's creature indestructible.
You control a number of artifacts greater than two times the indestructible creature's toughness.
1527-4911-5184.description:
Give an opponent's creature indestructible, if needed.
Activate Ghirapur Aether Grid by tapping two artifacts you control, dealing 1 damage to an indestructible creature an opponent controls.
If the creature has less than 0 toughness, Magmatic Galleon's second ability triggers, creating two Treasure artifact tokens.
Repeat from step 2.

1850-4261-4543.description:
Activate Trench Behemoth by returning Thornwood Falls from the battlefield to your hand, untapping it.
Play Thornwood Falls, triggering it and Fastbond.
Resolve the Thornwood Falls trigger, causing you to gain 1 life.
Resolve the Fastbond trigger, dealing 1 damage to you.
Repeat.

167-4050-4867.description:
Cast Not Dead After All by paying {B}, targeting Cormela.
Activate Phyrexian Altar by sacrificing Cormela, adding {B}.
When Cormela dies, it triggers twice, as well as any Wicked Role tokens that may be attached to it.
If applicable, resolve the Wicked Role trigger, causing each opponent to lose 1 life.
Resolve the first Cormela trigger, returning Not Dead After All to your hand from your graveyard.
Resolve the second Cormela trigger, returning Cormela from your graveyard to the battlefield tapped, and attaching a Wicked Role token to it.
Repeat.

4044-4237-4659-5220.description:
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Hovermyr, adding {C}{C}.
When Hovermyr dies, Mortuary triggers, putting Hovermyr on top of your library from your graveyard.
Cast Hovermyr from the top of your library by paying {2}.
Repeat.

546-1434-3008-5194.notablePrerequisites: At least six +1/+1 counters on Dragonsguard Elite.
546-1434-3008-5194.description:
Activate Dragonsguard Elite by paying {4}{G}{G}, doubling the number of +1/+1 counters on it.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to Dragonsguard Elite.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers, making Dragonsguard Elite become a copy of Ramos for as long as the equipment is attached to it.
Activate Dragonsguard Elite using Ramos's ability by removing five +1/+1 counters from it, adding {W}{W}{U}{U}{B}{B}{R}{R}{G}{G}.
Activate Blade of Shared Souls's equip ability by paying {2}, attaching it to any creature besides Dragonsguard Elite and ending the copy effect.
Blade of Shared Souls triggers; decline to use its ability.
Repeat.
Once there are infinite +1/+1 counters on Dragonsguard Elite, you may repeat the loop from step 2 infinite times, adding infinite mana.

628-1365-4659-4853.description:
Activate Cauldron of Souls by tapping it, giving Dross Scorpion persist until end of turn.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability, its undying ability and its persist ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the Dross Scorpion persist trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a -1/-1 counter on it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its undying ability.
Resolve the first Dross Scorpion trigger, untapping Cauldron of Souls.
Resolve the second Dross Scorpion trigger, returning it from your graveyard to the battlefield with a +1/+1 counter on it.
Activate Krark-Clan Ironworks by sacrificing Dross Scorpion, adding {C}{C}.
Dross Scorpion dies, triggering its ability and its persist ability.
Repeat from step 4.
